desc: The Medium Don't Tread on Me is a dual action OTF knife. Featuring a "Don't Tread on Me" Gadsden slogan laser engraved logo on one side and a "Snake" symbol laser engraved logo on the reverse side, Cerakoted aluminum alloy handle, top button trigger and is loaded with a high quality D2 steel blade. Includes a pocket clip, glass breaker for emergencies and nylon sheath.
